name: EA框架布局 (500.mq5)
summary: This EA is a trend-following framework built on top of a base class (EABaseFrame), using multiple moving average arrays to determine trade direction. Entry signals rely on MA direction checks and session time filters for US and non-US currency pairs. Exit conditions use MA direction reversal combined with a bar-based holding duration threshold, while add-position logic triggers when floating profit exceeds a multiple of current lot size.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于基类框架的趋势跟踪交易系统，使用多条移动平均线判断方向，配合美盘/非美盘时段过滤入场信号。出场条件依赖MA方向反转和持仓K线数阈值，加仓条件为浮盈超过当前手数的500倍对应点值。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于多周期移动平均线方向判断趋势，通过MA_Direction函数计算MA排列方向来决定多空。入场条件方面，LongOpen和ShortOpen函数中核心的MA判断逻辑目前被注释掉，实际不产生入场信号，处于未完成状态。出场条件依赖MA方向变化（2周期偏移1根K线）与持仓方向不一致时平仓，同时要求持仓K线数达到will_close_bars阈值。加仓条件为浮盈超过lots*500时追加初始手数。仓位管理使用lot_amplifier放大手数，以2000美金回撤10%为基准。时间过滤分别设定美盘和非美盘货币活跃时段，支持小时和分钟级精度控制。整体来看，策略框架完整但核心入场逻辑尚未实现，当前状态无法实际交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy's core concept is trend detection using multiple moving average arrays, where MA_Direction evaluates MA alignment to determine bullish or bearish bias. Entry conditions in LongOpen and ShortOpen rely on IsMAEverFit() which checks MA fitting across shifted arrays, but the critical calls are currently commented out, rendering the EA unable to generate actual entry signals. Exit conditions trigger when the MA direction (computed with period 2 and shift 1) diverges from the position's direction, provided the holding duration in H1 bars exceeds will_close_bars. Add-position logic activates when floating profit exceeds 500 times the current lots, adding the initial lot size without a specific price target. Position sizing uses a lot_amplifier multiplier calibrated against a 10% drawdown on $2000 capital. Session filtering supports separate US and non-US trading windows with fractional hour precision for minute-level boundaries. Overall, the framework is structurally complete but the core entry logic remains unimplemented, making it non-functional in its current state.

pros: 基于面向对象框架设计，继承EABaseFrame基类，代码结构清晰，易于扩展和维护
支持美盘和非美盘货币分别设定活跃时段，时间过滤精度到分钟级别，灵活性较好
加仓逻辑基于浮盈触发而非亏损加仓，避免了马丁格尔式的风险累积
使用多条MA组合判断方向，通过多次滑动窗口验证趋势，减少假信号
pros_en: Well-structured OOP design inheriting from EABaseFrame base class, clean architecture easy to extend and maintain
Separate US and non-US session time filters with minute-level precision offer good flexibility for different currency pairs
Add-position logic is profit-triggered rather than loss-based, avoiding martingale-style risk accumulation
Multiple MA arrays with sliding window validation reduce false trend signals
cons: 核心入场逻辑（LongOpen/ShortOpen中的IsMAEverFit调用）被注释掉，当前EA实际无法开仓交易
CheckReverse和CheckModify函数均为空实现，逆转和止损止盈修改功能缺失
IsInDealTime函数存在逻辑bug：第145行和第151行用小时值(hour)与分钟值(min)比较，条件判断有误
没有止损止盈的显式设置，仅依赖方向反转平仓，极端行情下风险不可控
硬编码交易品种为EURUSD，缺乏多品种适配能力
cons_en: Core entry logic (IsMAEverFit calls in LongOpen/ShortOpen) is commented out, the EA cannot actually open trades in its current state
CheckReverse and CheckModify are empty stubs, reverse and SL/TP modification features are missing
IsInDealTime has a logic bug: lines 145 and 151 compare hour values with minute values, making boundary conditions incorrect
No explicit stop-loss or take-profit settings, relying solely on direction reversal for exit creates unbounded risk in extreme markets
Hardcoded symbol EURUSD with no multi-instrument adaptation capability
improvements: 修复IsInDealTime中的边界条件bug，将第145行和第151行的us_right_hour/nus_right_hour改为对应的分钟变量
实现LongOpen和ShortOpen中被注释的入场逻辑，并增加止损止盈的显式设置以控制单笔风险
取消硬编码品种，从图表自动获取当前品种以支持多品种交易
improvements_en: Fix the boundary condition bug in IsInDealTime where hour values are incorrectly compared with minute values on lines 145 and 151
Implement the commented-out entry logic in LongOpen/ShortOpen and add explicit stop-loss/take-profit to control per-trade risk
Remove hardcoded EURUSD symbol and use the chart symbol automatically for multi-instrument support

risk_points: 核心入场逻辑被注释掉导致无法交易，但如果取消注释运行，缺乏止损机制在极端行情下可能造成大额亏损
加仓条件仅基于浮盈触发，没有加仓次数限制，连续加仓可能在趋势反转时扩大亏损
IsInDealTime时间过滤存在逻辑bug，可能导致在非预期时段开仓或错过交易窗口
risk_points_en: Entry logic is commented out making it non-trading, but if uncommented, lack of stop-loss could cause large losses in extreme moves
Add-position based solely on floating profit with no count limit can amplify losses on trend reversal
IsInDealTime logic bug may cause trades at unintended hours or missed trading windows
